items.t: Musician Max Korzh asked fans how Russia’s war against Ukraine has affected their lives. Here’s what they told him.
items.m: On November 12, musician Max Korzh posted this appeal on his Telegram channel, which has 246,000 subscribers: “Guys, if you’re being shelled, live near the fighting, or are right in the middle of it, record a voice message about your life. A voice message, because in a world of bots, text comments don’t feel like they’re coming from real people anymore. Don’t give away any precise information, like the times and locations of strikes — that’s for your own safety. […] Just tell us about your daily life, about what’s around you. […] I think everyone else needs to hear this.”
